# Doctors and Staff

---

## Meet Charleston GI Doctors

At Charleston GI, our medical team includes 10 outstanding board-certified gastroenterologists, with a combined experience of treating patients that exceeds 100 years. Our Physician Assistants each hold certification in their specialized field and update their skills regularly through continued education and training.

While Physician Assistants do not perform procedures, they offer a lot of value and direction for treatment. They provide additional medical care to ensure your concerns are addressed quickly. This proven approach is taken to accommodate both your schedule and our gastroenterologists.

Schedule an appointment 5 days a week, no referral needed! Charleston GI doctors are here to help!

In addition, our friendly, knowledgeable office medical staff are dedicated to managing your healthcare needs. From stomach, intestinal and digestive matters, our medical team strive in ensuring the best overall gastroenterology experience.

That is a higher standard of caring. That is Charleston GI.

# Charleston GI Specialists

Charleston GI Specialists is a Hospitals and Health Care company. Charleston GI is the largest independent gastroenterology practice in the lowcountry of South Carolina, providing the best patient experience and comprehensive care. Charleston GI Specialists employs 22 people (+1.3% YoY, +1 person) and has an annual revenue of $34.9M. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, United States, with offices in Mount Pleasant and Summerville.

## About

As the first and largest independent group of GI specialists in Charleston, our qualified team includes eleven outstanding board-certified gastroenterologists. With combined experience of over 100 years, our staff is wholeheartedly committed to providing the highest standard of care – close to home!
